candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum never updates MinSum.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so SetMinSum always resets MinSum to zero instead of setting it to the argument.
Negate the guard to 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so the first call reverts before setting MinSum.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum += _val;' so calls accumulate instead of overwriting MinSum.
Remove the intitalized guard so MinSum can be set even after initialization.
Add 1 to the assigned value so the stored MinSum differs from the argument.
Delete the assignment so MinSum keeps its previous value.
Delete the statement 'LogFile = Log(_log);' so the LogFile address is never set and remains address(0).
Replace the assignment 'LogFile = Log(_log);' with 'LogFile = Log(msg.sender);' so the stored LogFile address is the caller rather than the argument.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the caller's recorded balance never increases on Put.
Replace the guarded unlockTime update with an unconditional assignment `acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp+_lockTime;` so repeated small lock times can shorten the unlock time.
Delete the `LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put");` call so Put no longer records a log entry in the Log contract's History.
